question: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) is a _______ company.
solution:
The correct answer is **Maharatna**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

- Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) is a **Maharatna** company. - The **Maharatna** status is granted to select public sector enterprises in India. - BHEL is a leading company in the **energy-related** and **infrastructure sector** in India. - The **Government of India** awards the Maharatna status based on certain criteria, including net worth and profitability. - BHEL has a significant presence in the **power generation** and **transmission** sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL)** is one of the largest engineering and manufacturing companies in India. Established in 1964, it primarily operates in the **power generation** and **transmission** sectors, offering products and services for thermal, hydro, and nuclear power plants. BHEL also caters to industries such as **transportation**, **renewable energy**, and **defense**. The company has a significant presence both in India and globally, with a strong track record of delivering high-quality engineering solutions
